body.x: DisplayLink participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a wireless VR solution “DisplayLink XR.”

DisplayLink possesses technologies used for world’s prominent PCs and PC accessories, and manufactures chips and software. It supports multi-display extension through connection between wired and wireless VR, monitors, docking stations, video adaptors, etc. Presently, the usual VR solution requires long cable tethers between the head-mounted display and the game PC or console. However, with the wireless display connection embodied by the technologies of “DisplayLink XR”, the user of VR or AR can move much more freely, and can use application programs of completely new scope in the fields of game, simulation, education, and commerce. Especially, DisplayLink XR is not less in the aspects of video quality, delay time, or frame speed than the wired solutions.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
